name: The Park Avenue Grey Three-Piece Wool Suit
description:
Crafted for discerning gentlemen seeking absolute distinction, The Park Avenue Grey Three-Piece Wool Suit embodies the pinnacle of Park Avenue sartorial excellence. Cut from pristine Super 150s Italian Virgin Wool (Biella, Italy) woven with a 280g/m four-season weight, offering fluid drape, natural thermal balance, and resilient shape retention., each jacket features a full-canvas chest piece that molds naturally to the wearer's anatomy over time, creating a bespoke drape unmatched by ready-to-wear alternatives.

Hand-finished with subtle pick-stitching along the lapels, genuine horn buttons, and functional sleeve cuffs, this two-piece ensemble effortlessly commands boardroom presentations, diplomatic galas, and high-stakes social occasions across the United States. The trousers feature a refined mid-rise cut, curtain waistband, and pick-stitched slant pockets for unwavering comfort and structural poise.
fabric: Super 150s Italian Virgin Wool (Biella, Italy) woven with a 280g/m four-season weight, offering fluid drape, natural thermal balance, and resilient shape retention.

name: Egyptian Giza 87 Twill Formal Dress Shirt
description: Crafted from long-staple Egyptian Giza 87 cotton woven in a lustrous 140/2 two-ply twill, this bespoke dress shirt represents the gold standard of formal shirting. Finished with genuine Australian mother-of-pearl buttons, single-needle 22-stitches-per-inch tailoring, and removable solid brass collar stays.
careInstructions: Machine wash gentle 30C or specialist laundry

name: Sea Island Knit Silk-Cotton Sartorial Polo
description: The epitome of refined Riviera elegance. Spun from 70% West Indian Sea Island cotton and 30% fine mulberry silk, this knitted polo features a fashioned shirt-style collar, three-button Trocas shell placket, and fine ribbed cuffs.
fabric: 70% West Indian Sea Island Cotton, 30% Mulberry Silk
careInstructions: Hand wash in cold water or specialist dry clean
Dry flat away from direct heat

name: Todd & Duncan 4-Ply Scottish Cashmere Crewneck
description: Spun in Kinross, Scotland by world-renowned yarn masters Todd & Duncan, this 4-ply cashmere crewneck delivers exceptional thermal weight, velvety handle, and peerless pilling resistance. Finished with hand-linked neckbands and seamless raglan shoulders.
careInstructions: Hand wash cold with cashmere shampoo

name: Bespoke Cable Knit Cashmere Rollneck
description: An iconic statement of autumnal luxury. Featuring deep dimensional cable knits woven from pure 3-ply Mongolian cashmere, an architectural rollneck collar that holds its form, and ribbed waist and cuffs.
fabric: 100% Pure Mongolian Cashmere (3-Ply Heavy Cable Knit)

name: Hand-Burnished Balmoral Dress Boots
description: Handcrafted by master cordwainers using French Annonay box calfskin and English suede shaft panels. Built with genuine 360-degree Goodyear-welted construction, storm welt sealing, and British Dainite studded rubber soles for all-weather traction.
fabric: French Annonay Box Calfskin & English Suede Upper
careInstructions: Polish regularly with Saphir Medaille d Or
Use cedar shoe trees after every wear

name: Goodyear-Welted Wholecut Oxford Shoe
description: The pinnacle of formal cordwaining. Cut from a single flawless piece of French crust calfskin with zero seam lines, featuring a hand-burnished violin-waist bevelled leather sole and closed-channel stitching.
fabric: Single-Piece French Crust Calfskin with Oak-Bark Tanned Leather Sole

name: Belgravian Tasselled Belgian Loafers
description: Distinguished by supple deerskin construction, hand-knotted calf tassels, and ultra-flexible Goodyear-welted leather soles. Effortless sophistication tailored for salon lounging, black-tie soirées, and metropolitan weekends.
fabric: Hand-Sewn Deerskin & Calfskin with Soft Flex Leather Sole

name: High-Rise Single Pleat Flannel Trousers
description: Crafted from heavy 340g Vitale Barberis Canonico wool flannel. Tailored with a traditional high rise, forward single pleat, side buckle adjusters, and pick-stitched slant pockets with generous 5cm cuffing allowance.
fit: High-Rise Classical Cut with Side Adjusters
careInstructions: Hang by hem on clamp hanger

name: Kurabo Mills Japanese Selvedge Jeans
description: Woven on vintage Toyoda shuttle looms in Kojima, Japan from 14.5oz ring-spun Zimbabwe cotton. Finished with custom copper rivets, vegetable-tanned leather patch, and a clean tailored trouser silhouette.
fabric: 14.5oz Kurabo Mills Raw Indigo Selvedge Denim
careInstructions: Wash inside-out cold after 6 months wear

name: French Plonge Lambskin Sartorial Biker Jacket
description: Impeccably tailored from hand-selected 0.7mm French plongé lambskin. Butter-soft hand, Swiss Excella antiqued brass hardware, and heavy cupro silk lining engineered for timeless metropolitan elegance.
fabric: 100% Full-Grain French Plonge Lambskin with Cupro Silk Lining

name: Sovereign Double-Breasted Cashmere Overcoat
description: The definitive winter overcoat. Cut from 650g/m double-faced pure cashmere by Loro Piana, featuring generous Ulster lapels, martingale back half-belt, and hand-stitched horn buttons.
careInstructions: Store with cedar hanger in breathable garment bag

name: Handcrafted Grenadine Silk Garza Fina Tie
description: Woven on wooden shuttle looms in Lake Como, Italy. Untipped 3-fold construction with hand-rolled borders and pure wool interlining for a flawless dimple knot.
fabric: 100% Como Woven Grenadine Silk (Garza Fina, Italy)

name: Pleated Irish Linen Tailored Walk Shorts
description: Cut from breathable 280g Irish linen woven by Baird McNutt. Forward double pleats, extended tab button waistband, side buckle adjusters, and tailored 8.5-inch inseam.
careInstructions: Machine wash gentle cold or dry clean
